title: Retrospective transmit beamforming
question: Can stored focused transmits be combined after the fact into a transmit beam that is focused at every depth?
description: Broadband field simulation of K focused transmits (physical beams) and the RTB synthetic transmit beam for one receive line; opens at K = 1 (maps identical) and plays K up to 41 and the transmit spacing, with delay models, weights, sound-speed error and tissue motion.
validation: Own frequency-domain point-source solver, validated against an independent Python time-domain solver (amplitude NRMSE of 0.04 % or less on 5 settings); K = 1 gives identical maps A and B.
credit: Inspired by J. Honer's LinkedIn post on retrospective transmit focusing (Nov 2026); primary literature under References.
